purpose: Website introductions; manuscript titles, abstracts and keywords are unchanged.

the-logical-starting-point-of-mathematic.summary: Why begin with change? This research programme connects the formation of mathematical objects, physical structures and finite computations, and explains which questions are pursued by each branch.

prime-decomposition-and-operator-respons.summary: Prime factorization acquires an operator realization: the degree-one decomposition Hodge flow isolates prime modes with error exp(-tau), while linked occupation spaces recover zeta and reciprocal-zeta traces.

a-spectral-criterion-for-emergent-gravit.summary: A source-resolved spectral criterion links long-range two-helicity exchange to a positive zero-mass residue, matter energies and universal coupling, with explicit control of finite-approximation errors.

coarse-graining-and-long-range-response.summary: When does a reduced model preserve a measured interaction? Exact response identities and quantitative pole-and-residue bounds track source coupling, observations and the memory left by eliminated coordinates.

the-spectrum-of-a-compact-internal-space.summary: One generated source connects the Standard Model gauge quotient, a sixteen-dimensional matter carrier, a complex weak doublet and an attained positive gap of the generated Yang–Mills response.
The common spectral calculation selects three fermion generations, imposes linked mass and coupling relations, and reports 41 comparison entries together with seven groups of observable tests.

Cosmic structure is followed through field and object descriptions while unresolved influence is retained in residuals and memory. Finite-window estimates control forces, trajectories and observable errors.

dynamics-of-generated-spectra-from-minim.summary: Nonlinear evolution creates frequencies absent initially. A common spectral-weight gap controls both the initial tail and the discarded nonlinear source, yielding uniform finite-cutoff error certificates.

certified-spectral-computation-for-semil.summary: Finite records certify an infinite-dimensional nonlinear trajectory without rerunning its producer. For the encoded Neumann family, construction, record length and checking have explicit polynomial bit-cost bounds.

a-spectral-construction-of-natural-numbe.summary: Natural-number arithmetic is constructed together with its generating expressions. Histories with the same value can have different later responses, and eliminating those differences produces an exact memory equation.
